title: PVL: Eya Laure shows out in front of big Cebu crowd

blocks.text: CEBU CITY — Eya Laure proved that she is built for the big moments, delivering when the pressure peaked to power Choco Mucho’s comeback win over revamped Capital1 in the Premier Volleyball League’s 10th anniversary opener on Saturday at the SM Seaside Cebu Arena. Before a pressure-packed environment and an ecstatic 12,105 crowd, Laure took matters into her own hands, scoring six of her 22 points in the fifth set in a dramatic 22-25, 18-25, 25-17, 25-20, 15-8 win for an impressive start in the All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series.
